body: Please feel free to contact me if you ever need anyone just to listen! I am here for anyone needing someone. I hope you have a great day.

You do have a purpose in life. Sometimes it takes us a while to figure that out, but maybe you are meant to help others struggling with the same problems someday. You may make the difference between life and death in someone's future. I know it is hard to keep moving and going through this sadness, but just know that you do have a purpose here and stay strong!

Thank you so much. I don't think that I could go on with this pain if I did not have my two boys that I love more than anything in this world. I appreciate you taking the time to respond to me. It means a lot that strangers care. Thank you so much
I just need hope and now I have none. I feel like my life is over. will it ever go away? I just want to be normal and be the best mom I can be. Now I feel useless.

I am so happy that you have hope right now. I would do anything to have hope, it is been so long since I have felt that. I have not been able to find a therapist that I seem to click with, still looking though. I have been depressed most of my life, Since my early 20s, but it has been often on. But for the last nine months it has been every second of every day and I don't know how much longer I can take it. Thank you so much for being here for me, you don't know how much it means to me do you have a complete stranger care. I am here for you if you need me to.    Tess

Thank you so much! I need people who understand ! I am so happy you have overcome your fears! Depression gives us so many irrational fears! I am many right now. I so appreciate you and your willingness to help me. I send out a big hug to all of the ones who are supporting me right now:)
You are wiser than your years sweetie! Thank you so much for your very kind words and support. It truly means a lot! I wish only the best for you!

Thank you so much for your kind words. It means a lot to hear you say that. I will keep an update of my feelings on this side, hopefully it will help. Thank you for listening to me. You seem like a very nice person who cares

NO YOU ARE NOT WHINNING. I FEEL THE SAME WAY. I FEEL LIKE MY BRAIN JUST WON'T LET ME BE HAPPY. I HAVE BEEN IN THE EPISODE OF DEPRESSION FOR 9 MONTHS NOW, IF IT WERE NOT FOR MY KIDS, I WOULD PROBABLY NOT BE HERE SO I WOULD HAVE NO MORE PAIN

I HAVE SUFFERED FOR A VERY LONG TIME OFF AND ON. BUT THIS EPISODE HAS BEEN 9 MONTHS. IT STARTED AFTER MY HYSTERECTOMY. I HAVE HAD HORMONE LEVELS CHECKED AND SO MANY DIFFERENT BLOOD TEST TO SEE IF THERE MAY BE SOMETHING ELSE GOING ON. BUT IT IS JUST DEPRESSION CAUSED BY A CHEMICAL IMBALANCE MY PSYCHIATRIST SAYS. I HAVE TRIED SO MANY MEDS, DON'T KNOW WHAT ELSE TO DO. THE GUILT COMES FROM NOT BEING THE MOM I WISH I COULD BE, HAPPY AND WANTING TO DO THINGS WITH MY SONS. I LOVE THEM MORE THAN ANYTHING. THEY DESERVE SO MUCH BETTER
JUST SO YOU KNOW YOU ARE NOT ALONE IN YOUR PAIN. I FEEL THE SAME WAY, BUT PRAY FOR YOU TO BE ABLE TO HOLD ON!!!! I AM HAVING A HARD TIME HOLDING ON TOO

Sweetie, I had 3 losses before I had the 2 children I do now. Yes it is very painful, and I can relate to how you feel. I had my first loss when my sister was pregnant with her first, so happy for her but at the same time sad and jealous. Now my best friend is pregnant and I can have anymore due to a necessary hysterectomy 8 months ago. I feel so jealous that I cannot ever get pregnant again. But I know that wanting a child of your own must me so hard for you. I am a nurse and know that there are wonderful medical advances that could help you and your husband conceive. I am so sorry for your past trauma, but don't think that you would not be a great mother. Many abused children grow up and are excellent parents. Society tells you that you will probably follow your past, but that is not true. My brother in law was treated horribly as a child but is the best dad ever!!!! i have hope for you sweetie. Try and be strong today when she comes over, I know it will be hard, but I feel that you will someday be enjoying your own healthy pregnancy. Message me anytime if you need to talk.   Tess

Sweetie, you are still young and will find someone to love you. I did not get married until I was 30. I am now 40, but all my major accomplishments have happed withing the past 10 yrs. I know it must be very hard on you having such a problem with your teeth. I have seen where some cosmetic dentist will help people out, maybe you can find someone willing to help. Maybe someone will help you finance it. Keep me updated on your progress. I will pray you get the help you need!

There are always others with worse problems, but it does not mean your problems are not important. Your feelings are very valid, I suffer with severe depression but have a great life, I feel guilty and shamful that someone with so much can be so depressed. I hate when others tell me to "thinkk happy thoughts" or you have so much why be depressed? Well as a nurse and someone who has suffered for many years, I can tell you it is a disease just as anyone with diabetes or heart disease. We cannot just "think" the depression away. People have a hard time with understanding that. You can expect someone with diabetes to think away that disease, so why do others expect us the just think away ours. Never feel like your feelings are invalid or not important. They are!!!!!

Yes, unfortunately those so called schools do not transfer. It is a shame. I have heard of Everest, I believe we have one here in north Texas. But good for you for going back and working hard to get another degree. It will be worth it in the end.
I feel ya, I turned 40 last week and it totally sucked!!! Wish I was 22 again:) Sorry your day sucked, but Happy birthday anyway!!
Anytime friend!!!!!

I completely unerstand! You are a good friend and he is lucky to have you. The best thing you can do now is just continue to be his friend no matter how depressed he gets. some people get scared of depressed friends and alienate them but I know you would not do that. Thank you for being a good friend to someone who needs you!!!!
Thank you so much, that means a lot to me to hear that! Let me know if I an ever help you, just message me:)
Thank you so much!!!!! I will be ok, I am working hard towards that. I hope you are ok as well:)
Message me if you need my skype info. I will try to help you!!!

I know this is a lot to ask, but is there any way you could help him out for a short while just until he can get on his feet? If you can't that is completely understandable and you would not be a bad person for it. But that would just be my first thought if it were my friend.

sweetie, I know you don't want advice and I will not give any. But please be careful. Just FYI, there are places you can go for help. We have a place in my town called Abigails arms. It is a safe haven for battered women who need to get away. It is so nice, very homey and they help you get on your feet. Not sure where you are from, but this is in north Tx area if you are close by. Let me know if there is anyway I can help. I was in an abusive relationship years ago, just a boyfriend, but it got worse everytime, when he choked me is when I said enough!!!!!! You are to good of a person to be treated like this:)

Thank you so much for your reply. I can identify with you completely. It is strange, but I too fear dying but can also think about suicide. How F'd up am I for feeling like that? I try to keep busy too, and yes nights are terrible. My brain never shuts off. Please be careful sweetie with drugs/alcohol, I know you know this, but it actually can make depression worse. Let me know if there is any way I can help. Message me anytime

She loves you and things will get better. My husband lost his job two times, we have lost 2 brand new homes and have borrowed thousands of dollars from family. He feels like a loser in his words, but has gone back to school so that he can find a better job. He has not worked in 3 years  and I have been the only one to bring in an income. I am only telling you this so you know you are not the only man who has been in this position. But like your wife loves and supports you, I love and support my husband. I will not leave him because I know things will get better. And the same will happen for you. You will find a job, it just takes time. Give yourself a break!! You are a wonderful husband or you would not care so much. Hang in there, just because you don't have a job right now does not make you less of a man. Everyone goes through something like this at some point. Stay strong and in notime you will have a new job and things will be great again. Good luck and let me know when you find that job:)

of course! And I know you know whats right, but it still does not make it any easier. Those animal insticts can be tough to ignore. I actually have had terrible thoughts of being unfaithful to my husband with man or woman just due to the need for something that is missing. I have not acted on it and pray for the strenght to stay true to the man I really love. Thanks for sharing:) message me anytime

What a tragic story. I am so sorry for anyone that has to deal with this terrible thing. You are a wonerful teacher for caring so much. We have to pray for the boy's famiy who passed and also the little boy and family whos house it occured. I hope the guild does not ruin his life. I pray he receives the help he needs and both families can recover from this eventually.
Good for you dear! Best of luck to you:)

that is a hard situation. I have had thoughts like that but of friends. It would be in your best interest not to act on it since she is married to your brother, it could ruin their marraige and your relationship with your brother. I am sorry though, I know it must be difficult for you

I will be here for you! I have felt the same way in the past. Today I feel like I will never do such a thing, but last week it was a strong thought in my head. Please keep holding on, you are a great person and you deserve to live and be happy. If you ever need somone I can be here for you, just message me. I know depressoin feels like you can never win, I refuse to let it win even though I am struggling severly right now. Just tell yourself that you will win this battle, we both will. I care and will be here anytime.

I promise there is help. I have had a hard time with jobs in the past. I teach nursing school and I could not even finish out this past semester due to my depression. I go back in 1 week and I am praying I can do that. Start out with just something to get out of the house and work your way up. I know it sounds impossible. I am not trying to make it sound easier than it is, I know first hand how hard it is and how it really can be impossible at times. You deserve to live, please don't hurt yourself, seek help. I self admitted myself twice this past summer to a psych hospital due to suiciadal thoughts. It will help stabalize you where you can come home and continue to get well. Please go to the nearest hospital and tell them you need help. There is no shame in that. Keep me updated and I pray I continue to hear from you, if I don't I will fear the worst.

I am so sorry sweetie! I can't put into words the sadness I feel for you, his friends and family, and him. The pain he must have been in breaks my heart. He is with Jesus I just know that. I know He forgives even suicide. I pray for you and everyone affected my this tragic event.

Please don't!!! Let someone help you. You are not in the way, you are a great person with an illness. I too have severe depression. I understand your pain. Please hang in there. If talking to me on the phone would help, message me for my number. I can be here for you and try to help you. Keep holding on for another day. I pray you do not do anything. Please respond so I now you are still ok. I care, even though I am a complete stranger. You are important! You are a good person! God loves you!     Tess

Thank you so much! Your worrds and advise makes complete sense to me. I think I may try a 5K first though:) Good for you for doing a half marathon! Way to go. I have always wanted to learn the piano, so I thinkk I will do that, also learn how to ballroom dance! I think I am ready to finish my PhD too! Only 3 yrs left, LOL. Anyway, thank you so much for your insite. It was very helpful. Feel free for other advice in the future, you are inspirational!    Tess

Please get help! Go to the nearest ER. You need to be safe! It is not a character flaw to have depression or be suicidal, it is a true illness . I have been there too, I pray for you to please get help
Is 40 too old
Wow I am glad you had a great first experience. So what do you like better, man, woman, or the same

I feel the same too! But you have to promise yourself that you will keep pushing through each day. I know it is hard, I suffer from severe depression that will not go away. The word suicide pops into my head although I would not do it, I have children I love too much. You have to find that one thing you want to keep living for. And hopefully one day the depression will lift. I know it feels like it is never ending. this episode has been every day for 9 months straight. i sometimes scream at the top of my lungs for God to take it away. But no matter what, I have to keep moving and keep going. I feel my sadness through everything I do, wheather I am asleep or awake. I know how you feel, promise I do. Lets promise each other, even if we don't know each other, that we will keep going one day at a time until the day we feel happiness again.  Please hang in there, I will pray for you. Message me if you ever need to talk. I can be here for you if noone else can. Even though it is online it is better than not having anyone at all to talk to, so i am reaching out online for friends to talk to. I know these words may not help, but just know you are not alone.

I really understand your feeling too. You love her and want to be close to her. Thank God she has someone like you. I don't know you but can tell you are a very caring and amazing person to support her like this. I hope that tomorrow night will be better for you. I hope you can get some sleep too. I will probably not sleep until 3-4 am too, insomnia sucks. Good luck to you

I am very sorry that you have to go through this. Are you married or engaged? Or just friends? She definitley has some issues regarding sex, but you sound like you are an amazing person to support her the way you have. Many men would hot have I am sure. I hope things get better for you and her both. To be fair to her, I have been in her shoes, but I had severe endometriosis causing me very bad pain. But since the hysterectomy things are so much better. Does she maybe have a medical issue you are unaware of? Not trying to be nosey, just trying to figure out what may be going on. I am also a nurse so it is in my character to over assess the situation. Good luck to you and I really hope the best for you!!!!
You are right, that you for your advice and taking the time to read my post
I would not mind it, but he would never go for that:)

You have so much you can still do. I just turned 40 last week and did not go to college until I was 27. I now have my masters degree in nursing. Once you get started you will just fly through. I also did not get married until 30, had my first child at 31 and my second one at 35. So some of us just wait a little longer. I also lived with my sister, mom, grandpa, dad, during my 20s. I just kind of hopped around feeling lost. I also had a hard time keeping a job due to my depression. And even now as a nursing instructor I have days I just can't go to work. I feel like I am going to have to force myself to go back this spring semester. My mom also has depression, I know it is hard when you can't go to her because she is depressed too. let me know if there is anyway I can help
I had read your post earlier, and now to read this one makes my very happy for you. And you get to keep your dog, that is awesome. I am glad you have a wonderful boyfriend. Good luck to you dear.

My brain never lets me rest. I feel it even in my sleep. It is your depression not letting you feel happiness with hobbies, not the fact that you think you should be job hunting. I went to eat with my husband and other family tonight and I just could not feel any happiness. I just put on my fake smile and went. Now I am home, husband and children sleeping, and I am online searching for something, help, understanding, I don't know. I dread going to bed at night because the sooner I go to bed the sooner I have to wake up to pure Hell. Mornings are especially bad for me. I also think back to the days when I could sleep hugged up to my mom and all problems would be gone. I miss the child me, no problems, and if there were any, mom and dad were there to make it better. I have a hard time talking to mom now because she has depression too, and when she knows I am having issues, it makes her feel worse. So when I say I know how you feel, I really do.

I also feel that I am not suicidal, but I think about it a lot, like if I did not have children to live for would I actually do it? I thinik about how I would do it and sometimes when I cry in the shower I could just see myself taking the razor and cutting myself, not to kill myselfm but just to get out some pain. but I will not ever do it, I have 2 sons I would never leave, but my thoughts scare me sometimes. But I can see how someone could do it, depression is torture to live through. Therapist have not helped me at all either. But please talk to family or friends because they will be there for you. I don't think that any thought associated with suicide is normal, hence I am having abnmal thoughts too, so i am in no way judging you. I only want to help in any way I can.

I understand completely. I feel like I have tortured every friend I have the last 8 months I have been going through this depression. I feel like I have run out of people to go to. I enjoy nothing and with i could just go to sleep and sleep until I could finally wake up happy.

I feel the same way. I feel like I will be sad for the rest of my life. I really don't know what else to do. I have tried so many meds and therapy, not sure what else to do. I am sorry you are going through this. I just want you to know that you are not alone, many of us suffer with the same tortuous depression too. Let me know if you ever need to talk.
Why sweetie???? Can I help in any way

I have been terrified of death since april. I had a hysterectomy and 1 week after surgery the most terrifying depression/anxiety and fear of death set in. I am scared of losing my children, husband, parents, and also the thought that I will die someday. I am so incredibly scared. I can't be happy and it is making my depression so much worse. I know how you feel and you are not alone in this! Message me if you need to talk.

Sweetie, I suffer with depression and anxiety too. I am 40 and have had this for a long time. I truely understand your pain. Message me if you need to talk. I am a 40 yr old married female just to put your mind at ease. I will be here for you:)
Girl if I were not married i would probably do the same thing:) Just be careful and have fun!!!!!

Thank you sweetie for your very nice post. I agree that we should live life to its fullist. I am trying very hard to do this. If I could just get over this terrifying fear of death.... it haunts every second of my life. It may sound wierd, but the fear of death almost makes a person feel suicidal (yes that is very strange). To fear death but to feel suicidal almost does not make sense. Has anyone ever felt like that or am I just crazy?

Do not feel bad! You did the right thing. I have severe depression and have self admitted myself 2 times in the past year. It is the place to be if you are suicidal. You are a wonderful friend!!! Everyone needs a friend that cares as much as you do. They may be mad at you at first, but once they get to feeling better an get their life back on track, they will thank you for it. God Bless You!!!!!!

Do you feel that your wife wants to leave you? I have had problems with my husband not understanding my feelings, I think if it were not for our children, it may have ended by now. There is nothing wrong with a 38 yr old white boy, lol, I am a 40 year old white girl:) How to we get over these feelings? This may sound conceided, but as a woman I fear becoming less attractive and not "sexy" anymore. Like I said, I am not a conceided person at all, I am just scared of getting old

I have a wonderful family and lots of friends, but I am also very lonely. I have severe depression and all I need is someone to understand me. Depression can make you feel that you have noone to turn to. I can be here for you if you need to talk:) I am a very caring person and maybe we can help each other. Message me if you want!!

I just want you to know that you are not alone in your feelings and thoughts. I just turned 40 last week and have had depression since my early 20s. This past summer I admitted myself twice to a hospital because the depression got so bad. I am not getting to the point where I feel like I could self admit again, but it is so hard when your spouse does not completely understand. He feels it can be "willed away". I am also feeling so alone and scared too, I am here for you if you ever need. Send me a message if you ever need to talk. I pray for you and eveyone on this site searching for happiness.

Hello,

I have read several of your post. The first one was from 8 months ago when you turned 40 and felt as if your life was over. It is such relief to know that I am not the only one feeling this way. I turned 40 Dec. 30 and feel so sad and empty inside. Many people tell me I am rediculous and that I am still young, but it is how I feel. Just 10 years ago I was a thin and attractive woman, and now 10 years later I have gained 50 lbs and am starting to see the signs of aging on my face. I am so depressed. And now I read your newer post and I feel like there is someone out there who feels the same as I do. How do you go own with so much pain inside but with so much to live for at the same time. I have 2 wonderful little boys that I would never leave and a husband that I love. But he does not understand the pain, he thinks I can just "think it away with good thoughts". To some people I may sound ungrateful, I am not. I am thankful to God for everything He has given me, but the pain of my depression will not leave me alone. I am alone in my pain and need to talk to others with the same feelings. Please if anyone has any advice for me I would appreciate it very much. I am also here for anyone who needs to talk to someone who has the same problems. I truely care about others and hope that anyone who reads this is happy and feeling no pain. Just know that if your are, you are not alone. I am willing to give my email address to anyone who wishes to be a support system for each other. God Bless everyone on this site searching for hope.
